evaluation_guidance: Resolve readiness, evaluator, rubric, and score basis from the selected benchmark record. Report local sample verdicts and optional remote VJudge verdicts separately from collaboration quality. Prefer Accepted with diagnosis-backed recovery after rejects. Do not reward message volume alone.

scoring.evaluator_selection: Use each benchmark record's evaluation; rule values are defaults only.

submission.adaptation: submit_code judges samples locally and may forward to the VJudge gateway when configured; remote AC finalizes.
